LESSON: PLACES OF WORSHIP • DURGA POOJA, • AYAMBIL, • VESAK • GURPURAB

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Religious Practices
Topic 4.2: Places of Worship • Durga Pooja, • Ayambil, • Vesak • GurPurab
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 16

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Places of Worship • Durga Pooja, • Ayambil, • Vesak • GurPurab, part of Religious Practices in Grade 7 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How do celebrations of festivals at places of worship help in inculcating moral values in our lives?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. use digital devices/digital devices with assistive technology for learners with special needs /resource persons/ library, to research on religious practices,

2. attend at least one of the listed festivals and discuss their findings with peers,

3. prepare and present a creative piece of artwork on their understanding of the commonalities of the religious practices in the four faiths,

4. interact with a resource person(s) on the commonalities of the religious practices in the four faiths. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. use digital devices/digital devices with assistive technology for learners with special needs /resource persons/ library, to research on religious practices,
2. attend at least one of the listed festivals and discuss their findings with peers,
3. prepare and present a creative piece of artwork on their understanding of the commonalities of the religious practices in the four faiths,
4. interact with a resource person(s) on the commonalities of the religious practices in the four faiths. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Places of Worship • Durga Pooja, • Ayambil, • Vesak • GurPurab together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

• Communication and Collaboration: learner enhances communication and collaboration when attending at least one of the

listed festivals.

• Digital Literacy: learner will interact with digital technology when preparing and presenting creative pieces of artwork on

their understanding of the commonalities of the religious practices in the four faiths.
